description: Source code implementing input handling classes for Chromium in Playwright, including keyboard, mouse, and touchscreen interactions.

classes.name: RawKeyboardImpl
classes.description: Implements keyboard input handling for Chromium, including key events and shortcuts.

classes.name: RawMouseImpl
classes.description: Handles mouse input events such as move, click, wheel, and drag.

methods.name: _commandsForCode
methods.description: Generates command list based on key code and modifiers for Mac shortcuts.

methods.name: keydown
methods.description: Sends a key down event with modifiers and handles special cases like drag cancellation.

methods.name: move
methods.description: Moves mouse cursor, optionally for click or drag.

methods.name: tap
methods.description: Simulates a touchscreen tap at specified coordinates.
